scope: Italy V9 second pass; first pass remains complete

investigations.tariffModel: site-owner configurable pricing on Sagelio platform
investigations.tariffChannel: direct/ad-hoc possible by card; roaming partners separate
positiveEvidence: Sagelio current site states operators have control over pricing in the platform.
Sagelio article dated 2026-04-15 explicitly says there is no tariff valid for all sites and gives 0.59 EUR/kWh only as an example chosen by a retail operator.
Sagelio supports direct card payment via QR; historical documentation states card price follows the station/Electromaps price plus Stripe fees, so direct payment exists but remains station-specific.
negativePaths: Do not promote the 0.59 EUR/kWh worked example to the network.
Do not inherit Be Charge/Electromaps roaming prices as direct Sagelio tariffs.
investigations.blockage: No deterministic network-wide tariff; exact current station price must be resolved per station/connector.
investigations.resumeCondition: Resolve Sagelio/Electromaps station detail or QR backend and map SAG PUN EVSE to exact station price.

investigations.tariffModel: station-specific / tariff selected in map-app; no current public network grid established
investigations.tariffChannel: DriWe/Unoenergy app-map direct workflow; roaming separate
positiveEvidence: Unoenergy current page confirms a map/app workflow to view, reserve and pay at Unoenergy DriWe chargers.
DriWe FAQ states charging cost depends on the selected electricity tariff rather than publishing a public CPO-wide tariff.
corroboration: PUN-derived Pienotto station pages for UnoEnergy DriWe state that tariffs have not been communicated to PUN.
negativePaths: No current official network-wide direct tariff was found.
Do not use domestic wallbox electricity examples as public CPO tariffs.
investigations.blockage: Exact public charging tariff must be resolved through the station/app detail; no deterministic bulk tariff endpoint established.
investigations.resumeCondition: Resolve Unoenergy DriWe public/app map payload and map DRW PUN EVSE to exact station tariff.
